rules:
A coin lies in each corner of a square table. 
Some are heads up, some tails up, but we can't see which is which. 
In one move, any number of coins, from 0 to 4, can be flipped. 
If all the coins land on the same side, the player wins. Otherwise, the table rotates by any angle, a multiple of 90 degrees. 
Solve the problem in the minimum number of moves.
